gold: Trifascicular block (Right bundle-branch block with alternating left anterior and left posterior fascicular block)

selector.rationale: Evidence of abnormal ECG findings, including right bundle-branch block, left anterior and posterior fascicular block, and prolonged PR interval, support cardiac conduction disease as the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Hypertensive heart disease
rejected.why: Mild concentric left ventricular hypertrophy is present, but not sufficient to explain the syncopal episode and ECG abnormalities.

rejected.label: Sick sinus syndrome
rejected.why: No clear evidence of sinus node dysfunction, and the presence of other conduction abnormalities makes this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Orthostatic hypotension
rejected.why: Vital signs were stable without considerable orthostatic changes in blood pressure and heart rate, contradicting this diagnosis.
